question: The Americas Regional Office of the NDB was announced in 2018 to be set up in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**São Paulo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **New Development Bank (NDB)**, also known as the BRICS Bank, is a multilateral financial institution established by the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) to support infrastructure and sustainable development projects.
 
• In **2018**, the NDB announced its plan to set up its **Americas Regional Office** to facilitate project financing and engagement in the Americas.
 
• **São Paulo**, the largest city in **Brazil**, was chosen as the location for the Americas Regional Office. This decision was influenced by São Paulo's status as an economic hub and its strategic importance in the region.
 
• The Americas Regional Office helps strengthen the bank’s presence in the region and supports its mandate to promote sustainable development and financial cooperation among BRICS nations. *Hence, São Paulo was the correct choice.*
